name: cross-agent
description: Delegate consultations and installed skills to explicitly configured agent CLIs with persistent task and provider session identities.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate consultations and skills to another agent CLI
interface.longDescription: Ask another configured agent CLI for a consultation, an independent opinion, or the execution of an installed skill, keeping task and provider session identities so the work can resume; save and resume work across sessions with verifiable checkpoints.
